      default org.springframework.ai.vectorstore.VectorStore createVectorStore(TurStoreInstance turStoreInstance, org.springframework.ai.embedding.EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, String decryptedCredential, String collectionNameOverride)
      Creates a VectorStore with a custom collection name override. Used when documents must be stored in a per-locale collection (e.g., the SN locale core name).

    • listCollections

      default List<TurStoreCollectionInfo> listCollections(TurStoreInstance turStoreInstance, String decryptedCredential)
      Lists all collections in the vector store. Providers that do not support collection listing return an empty list.

      default void deleteByMetadata(TurStoreInstance turStoreInstance, String decryptedCredential, String collectionName, String metadataKey, String metadataValue)
      Deletes embeddings from a collection that match the given metadata key/value. Used to remove old embeddings before re-indexing a file.

    • clearCollection

      default void clearCollection(TurStoreInstance turStoreInstance, String decryptedCredential, String collectionName)
      Clears all embeddings from a collection without deleting the collection itself.
